I recently visited Sanjivi Slim Clinic and wanted to share my honest experience.

The staff are very friendly and professional. Especially Santhoshi, who guided me really well and explained the entire process clearly. The doctor is also knowledgeable and only suggests treatments that are actually useful—he doesn’t recommend anything unnecessarily.

I first visited the clinic 3 days ago and was interested in joining, so I paid ₹5,000 on the same day. However, the next day I found out I have a hernia issue, and my home doctor advised me not to go for weight loss treatments like CoolSculpting.

So I went back to the clinic and explained my situation. The doctor and staff did not force me at all. They clearly said I should only proceed if I am 100% okay. Otherwise, they were ready to refund my ₹5,000 without any issue.

I requested a refund, and they agreed to return the amount.

Overall, I had a very positive experience—no pressure, honest guidance, and supportive staff. Really appreciate their professionalism.
